# ThreadSanitizer suppressions, consumed by CI via TSAN_OPTIONS=suppressions=...
#
# Only a verified false positive belongs here, and only with the reason it is one written
# beside it. A suppression over an unexplained report is worse than a red job: it buys a green
# tick and throws away the finding.

# b_plus_tree takes every node lock under tree_mutex_, held for the whole operation --
# exclusively by a writer, shared by a reader -- so a node lock is never contended. The
# deadlock detector still builds cycles out of node addresses: a descent locks parent then
# child, and remove locks the neighbour on either side of the node it holds.
deadlock:core::b_plus_tree

# boost::lockfree's freelist reads a tagged pointer speculatively and discards what it read
# when the ABA-protected CAS fails; the value is never used unless the CAS confirms it. That
# is not expressible to TSAN. manager_disk_t's inbox_ is one of these queues.
race:boost::lockfree
